basic_details.short_information: Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL) has released a notification for contract appointments in its Operation & Maintenance Wing to look after security and related works in Metro Stations and Depots.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 62 years as on the date of notification. Serving military personnel who are due to retire on or before 31.12.2026 may also apply.

qualification.education_qualification: Serving or Retired personnel from Defence services or State Police Department
qualification.details: Additional eligibility requirements: | Kannada knowledge is mandatory. This position is advertised for external candidates only. Internal employees of BMRCL, including Regular, Contract and Outsourced employees, are not eligible to apply. Candidates must provide a Medical Fitness Certificate issued by a Government Hospital for appearing in the Physical Fitness Test.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 32,950/- p.m (Below 60 age) / Rs. 30,000/- p.m (Above 60 age) (Grade - NE-3)
salary_details.details: Allowances are applicable as per the rules of the Company.

selection_process: The selection process consists of the following stages in order:
Physical Fitness Test (PFT) Written Test Interview

Candidates shall be required to complete a 1.5 km run within 10 min up to 11.30 min as per their age group. Early finishers will be awarded additional points. Only candidates who qualify in the Physical Fitness Test shall be permitted to appear for the Written Test.

exam_pattern.details: The Written Test shall be conducted after the Physical Fitness Test and will be of one-hour duration. It will be conducted in Kannada/English language and shall comprise Essay Writing and General Knowledge.

how_to_apply: Visit the BMRCL website at www.bmrc.co.in and navigate to the Careers section to access the relevant recruitment notification.
Select the post applied for and enter all required details in the online application form.
After submitting the online application, save and print the computer-generated application form.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph on the printed application form.

Send the printed application along with self-attested copies of required supporting documents through Speed Post or courier to the specified address, superscribing the envelope as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ASSISTANT SECURITY OFFICER".
important_instructions: All appointments will be on “contract basis” only. The tenure of contract appointment shall initially be for a period of 3 years for candidates below 60 years of age and 1 year for candidates above 60 years of age, and may be extended further based on performance and BMRCL requirements. Candidates who fail to send the hard copy of the application along with relevant documents will not be considered, even though they applied online. Any candidate found guilty of impersonation, submission of fabricated/false documents, incorrect information, or suppression of facts shall be liable for rejection of candidature. Shortlisted candidates shall attend the selection/interview at their own cost. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.

content_sections.heading: BMRCL Assistant Security Officer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: BMRCL has notified a total of 50 vacancies for the post of Assistant Security Officer (Grade - NE-3) in the Operation & Maintenance Wing.

content_sections.heading: BMRCL Assistant Security Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Additional eligibility requirements: Kannada knowledge is mandatory. This position is advertised for external candidates only. Internal employees of BMRCL, including Regular, Contract and Outsourced employees, are not eligible to apply. Candidates must provide a Medical Fitness Certificate issued by a Government Hospital for appearing in the Physical Fitness Test.

rows.qualification_required: Serving or Retired personnel in the rank of Junior Commissioned Officer or equivalent from Defence services (Indian Army/ Navy/ Indian Air force/ CAPF/CRPF/BSF/CISF and other allied equivalent services) or Inspector / Sub Inspector / ASI or equivalent rank from Karnataka State Police Department.

content_sections.heading: BMRCL Assistant Security Officer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 62 years as on the date of notification. Serving military personnel who are due to retire on or before 31.12.2026 may also apply.

content_sections.heading: BMRCL Assistant Security Officer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Allowances are applicable as per the rules of the Company.

content_sections.heading: BMRCL Assistant Security Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of the following stages in order: Physical Fitness Test (PFT) Written Test Interview Candidates shall be required to complete a 1.5 km run within 10 min up to 11.30 min as per their age group. Early finishers will be awarded additional points. Only candidates who qualify in the Physical Fitness Test shall be permitted to appear for the Written Test.

content_sections.heading: BMRCL Assistant Security Officer Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Written Test shall be conducted after the Physical Fitness Test and will be of one-hour duration. It will be conducted in Kannada/English language and shall comprise Essay Writing and General Knowledge.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for BMRCL Assistant Security Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the BMRCL website at www.bmrc.co.in and navigate to the Careers section to access the relevant recruitment notification. Select the post applied for and enter all required details in the online application form. After submitting the online application, save and print the computer-generated application form. Affix a recent passport-size photograph on the printed application form. Send the printed application along with self-attested copies of required supporting documents through Speed Post or courier to the specified address, superscribing the envelope as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ASSISTANT SECURITY OFFICER".

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Recent passport-size photograph affixed on the application form Proof of age (Birth Certificate / 10th Standard Certificate) Educational qualification certificates from 10th Standard onwards up to the highest qualification Experience certificates relating to present and previous employment PPO & Discharge Certificate issued by the Competent Authority Employment Certificate issued by respective organization (for serving personnel) Medical Fitness Certificate issued by a Government Hospital

content_sections.heading: BMRCL Assistant Security Officer Important Instructions
content_sections.text: All appointments will be on “contract basis” only. The tenure of contract appointment shall initially be for a period of 3 years for candidates below 60 years of age and 1 year for candidates above 60 years of age, and may be extended further based on performance and BMRCL requirements. Candidates who fail to send the hard copy of the application along with relevant documents will not be considered, even though they applied online. Any candidate found guilty of impersonation, submission of fabricated/false documents, incorrect information, or suppression of facts shall be liable for rejection of candidature. Shortlisted candidates shall attend the selection/interview at their own cost. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available under BMRCL Assistant Security Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 50 vacancies available for the Assistant Security Officer post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications is 31/10/2026.

faq.question: Q3. By when must the signed print out of the application reach BMRCL?
faq.answer: The receipt of the signed print out of the application along with documents should reach by 04:00 PM on 05/11/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BMRCL Assistant Security Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 62 years as on the date of notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the consolidated salary for the Assistant Security Officer post?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is ₹ 32,950/- p.m for candidates below 60 years and ₹ 30,000/- p.m for candidates above 60 years of age.

faq.question: Q6. Who is eligible to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Serving or Retired personnel in the rank of Junior Commissioned Officer or equivalent from Defence services or Inspector / Sub Inspector / ASI or equivalent rank from State Police Department with mandatory knowledge of Kannada can apply.

faq.question: Q7. Is the job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: All appointments will be on a contract basis only, initially for 3 years for candidates below 60 years and 1 year for candidates above 60 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BMRCL Assistant Security Officer?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of a Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Written Test, and Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where should candidates send the hard copy of their application?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent by Speed Post/courier to the Dy. General Manager (HR), Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited, III Floor, BMTC Complex, K.H. Road, Shanthinagar, Bengaluru 560 027, superscribing the envelope as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ASSISTANT SECURITY OFFICER".
